title: Grateful Dead Live at Rich Stadium on 1989-07-04
lineage: mac > Nakamichi BX-125E > Emu 0202 > Wavelab 5 > wav 24/96 Wavelab 5 (with iZotope Ozone 4) > iZotope RX Advanced > wav 16/44.1 > CD Wave > TLH > flac16; from OTS
source: Nakamichi 300s (with cp1 caps) > Sony WM-D6 > mac

ai_review.summary: Good-quality audio captures a fun, high‑energy show highlighted by a strong Bertha opener and a smoking Deal to close the first set.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rate this performance four stars, praising the upbeat vibe, tight opening with "Bertha" and "The Greatest Story Ever Told," and a fiery "Deal" that caps the first set. The recording is described as clear enough for repeated listening despite minor slip‑ups and a slightly froggier Jerry vocal tone.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is consistently praised with standout songs noted; recording is good but has minor imperfections, leading to a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Minor mistakes and Jerry's voice sounding froggier than usual are mentioned; overall clarity is sufficient for enjoyable repeated listening.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy opening with "Bertha" and "The Greatest Story Ever Told," maintaining momentum through a smoking "Deal" to close the first set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocal tone described as froggier than usual for the late ’80s.
